item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory determination that the covered persons’ unrestricted entry is not detrimental, producing the operative legal predicate immediately rather than directing a later agency outcome.","evidence":"hereby find that the unrestricted entry into the United States of persons described in section 1 of Proclamation 10014 is not detrimental to the interests of the United States"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President immediately revokes the cited proclamations and provisions, thereby removing their entry suspension without requiring a later agency decision.","evidence":"Proclamation 10014, section 1 of Proclamation 10052, and section 1 of Proclamation 10131 are revoked."},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The named Secretaries must conduct an internal review and may revise agency guidance as appropriate; no specified later legal outcome is dictated, while the remaining language preserves existing executive authorities and functions.","evidence":"shall review any regulations, orders, guidance documents, policies, and any other similar agency actions developed pursuant to Proclamation 10014"}]}
